blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—As Undas approaches, large crowds are expected at two of Metro Manila’s major cemeteries, Manila North Cemetery and Manila South Cemetery. Visitors are advised to plan their trips ahead, including by using the cemeteries’ online grave finders and interactive maps to locate their departed loved ones’ burial sites before arriving. The two cemeteries have separate online tools for searching burial records and locating graves on a map. Manila North Cemetery’s website allows users to search for a deceased relative by name and view the grave’s location, while Manila South Cemetery’s new website features an interactive map that can guide visitors […]...
